title: Greatest Little Appliance!
text: Greatest Little Appliance!. I bought this appliance when it first came out and it still works great and I would be so lost without it!  I really got my monies worth with this item. Be assured if this one dies, I will definitely get another one! LOVE,LOVE,LOVE it!!!!  It bakes,broils,reheats! Everything is done faster,and the toast comes out perfect,never burnt!

product_metadata.title: Black & Decker Infrawave Oven
features: B&D Infrawave Oven With Broil Function
description: Oven uses infrared technology to cook anything you might prepare in a conventional oven, but in a fraction of the time and without preheating. Provides even, thorough cooking on all food types and provides superior browning and crisping. Choose one of the digital pre-settings and the Infrawave uses interior heating light technology to get things cooking quickly. At 20.25in.L x 15in.W x 20.5in.H, the Infrawave is large enough to prepare a 12in. pizza, but small enough to fit on your counter. Frame Material: Heavy duty ABS plastic, Dimensions L x W x H (in.): 20 1/4 x 15 x 20 1/4, LED Light: No, Includes: Digital pre-settings
